caption: The drawing depicts a single glass jug with a wide, flared rim, a rounded body, a small circular base, and a prominent, arched handle. The jug is rendered in various shades of blue and turquoise, with hints of green, suggesting it is made of colored glass. The use of lighter blue and white highlights on the surface indicates reflections, giving the appearance of transparency and gloss typical of glass objects. The background is plain and beige, with no other objects or details present, drawing full attention to the jug centered in the composition.
title: Miniature Cup (Blue)
